style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

judgeProposal.definitionOfGood: A crafted, worn wooden shelving obstacle in warm softly lit cartoon3D, with more readable construction and useful purposeful detail than the source, inside the frozen spatial/contact/capture/animation contract.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: The shelving reads as a heavy worn wooden assembly with a clear upper surface, load-bearing uprights/bracing, separated sagging shelf tiers and stored boxes. Rounded worn edges, chips, splitting planks and plausible joins improve the original plain box slabs. The detached board remains visibly related to the failed assembly.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidenceOfSuccess: At full native, logical448x672 and phone224x336, the top resolves as constructed wood rather than one blank golden rectangle; the shelf apertures and front/back/side volumes remain distinct. Useful native reconstruction is rewarded.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: Do not prescribe3topplanks,4old shelves,6boxes,18meshes or exact scratches. Do not make a clean new retail cabinet, remove the loose-board role or expand supports to achieve a target-sized screen silhouette.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: Broad natural-looking stylized wood grain, worn corner breaks and a few coherent fasteners/join cues provide crafted scale; box folds, tape or simple seams distinguish stored contents from the frame. New detail has depth or surface continuity appropriate to the object.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidenceOfSuccess: A small set of stable cues survives phone size, with larger readable planes at logical size; close views show deliberate finish. Back and sides carry coherent construction, and moving details remain attached to their carriers.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: No wallpaper-like repeated grain, noisy high-frequency scratch coverage, floating bolts, penetrating tape, flat target billboards or details that flicker/swim through clearance.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: Honey/ochre wood in the original warm brown family, brighter crown and warm mids with grounded darker cavities. Olive/tan/brown boxes and restrained dark metal accents separate functions.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidenceOfSuccess: Looks warmer and richer than the original muted ochre blocks without flattening wood, boxes and voids into one orange mass. Distinction survives neutral and dark backgrounds and phone scale.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: Do not copy exterior amber haze, black background, neon orange saturation or full-frame target grade. Exact target RGB values are not locks.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: Soft broad highlight rolloff and rounded/faceted edge definition reveal thickness, sag and chips. Shelf cavities retain readable warm midtones. Lighting is balanced under quarter turns.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidenceOfSuccess: Every facing carries soft form cues with no systematic left/right preferred key or dark unseen side. The large upper plane has visible soft volume; highlights support wood edges without white wire outlines.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: No directional ground shadow, dark lower cabinet dead band, clipped white edges, harsh black AO, unearned emissive glow or an exterior alpha halo.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: Clean coherent silhouette and native surfaces across all100frames. Apertures, shelf ends, support contacts and loose pieces stay readable; designed damage remains distinguishable from defects.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.evidenceOfSuccess: No coplanar shimmer, black seams, accidental pinholes, bevel blowouts, geometry collisions, clipping, detached additions or fuzzy fringe against light/gray/dark. Temporal playback retains source mechanics with no frame fit drift.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: Do not reject intentional worn wood notches or clearance scatter simply because it differs from idle; do not accept abrupt raw intersections as damage.

comparativeScoring.use: Comparative observations only; no universal numeric approval threshold. Technical success cannot substitute for useful visible improvement.
